login.title: Host area
login.oidcHint: Sign in with your identity provider.
login.joinHint: This instance requires an account. Signing in opens the application; the PIN opens the session you were invited to.
login.localHint: Local mode. No data is sent to any third party.
login.seatHeldBy: The host seat is held by {{name}} (no expiry). Enter the same name to continue as host; anyone else can only join sessions as a participant.
login.seatTaken: The host seat is already taken. You can only join sessions as a participant.
login.seatFree: Local mode: a single host seat. The first person to take it locks the host area; everyone else can only join sessions as a participant.
login.seatHeldByUntil: The host seat is held by {{name}} until {{until}}. Enter the same name to continue as host; anyone else can only join sessions as a participant.

landing.title: Interactive quiz
landing.demoTitle: What this demo does not do
landing.demoIntro: A shared playground for trying the builder and a live session — nothing else.
landing.demoSeat: One host at a time: the host seat lasts {{count}} min, renewable while you hold it.
landing.demoMedia: No media upload — images, audio and video are off, including inside an imported quiz.
landing.demoReset: Everything is wiped every hour: accounts, quizzes, archived results. A reset waits for a session in progress.
landing.demoSamples: The sample quizzes come back with the next host seat, as on a fresh install.
landing.demoStandalone: All-in-one image: application, database and cache in a single container, run here without a volume — a restart loses everything too. Fine for trying, not for production.
landing.demoSelfHost: Self-hosted, none of this applies: your instance keeps its data, uploads its media and hosts as many people as you allow.

claim.title: Take the host seat?
claim.explain: This instance runs in local mode without accounts: one host at a time. Taking the seat locks the host area for you.
claim.ruleOthers: While you hold it, other people can only join your sessions as participants.
claim.ruleRelease: It is released when you log out, or automatically when the expiry below is reached.
claim.ruleName: Your name is your key: entering it again (on any device) brings you back as host.
claim.demoExpiry_one: Public demo: the seat lasts {{count}} minute, renewable from your menu.
claim.demoExpiry_other: Public demo: the seat lasts {{count}} minutes, renewable from your menu.

seat.label: Host seat
seat.releaseHint: Give the host seat back; you stay signed in as a participant.
